sloka: दशयोजनविस्तारस्त्रिंशद्योजनमुच्छ्रितः ।धरण्यां समतां यातः स बभूव धराधरः ।। 5.56.33 ।।।।
transliteration: daśayojanavistārastriṁśadyojanamucchritaḥ ।dharaṇyāṁ samatāṁ yātaḥ sa babhūva dharādharaḥ ।। 5.56.33 ।।।।

translations.english: That mountain of ten yojanas in width and thirty yojanas in height got levelled with the earth.
